title: Why Mark Zuckerberg is secretly building AGI

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: Why might Mark Zuckerberg be quietly investing in AGI, despite the risks and public skepticism?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Current AI systems like GPT-4 and Gemini show progress, but AGI requires breakthroughs in neural architecture search and generalization.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: If AGI is developed without ethical guardrails, it could undermine labor, privacy, and even democratic institutions.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Teams are working on value alignment, interpretability, and fail-safes to ensure AGI systems act in human-interest aligned ways.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future AGI could solve climate change, cure diseases, and democratize education—if we get the alignment right.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The path to AGI is fraught, but with careful engineering and ethics, it could redefine what’s possible for humanity.
